question: To whom must the supremely rare vidyā never be given under any circumstance?
premises: The vidyā is described as supremely rare.
The text uses a universal prohibitive expression.
Transmission is framed as something to be withheld.
inference: The supremely rare vidyā must not be given to just anyone.
plain_english: This supremely rare vidyā must not be given to just anyone at all.
